source.author: verg
source.text: non ego nunc dulci amplexu divellerer usquam, nate, tuo, neque finitimo Mezentius umquam huic capiti insultans tot ferro saeva dedisset funera, tam multis viduasset civibus urbem.
source.text_original: non ego nunc dulci amplexu divellerer usquam, / nate, tuo, neque finitimo Mezentius umquam / huic capiti insultans tot ferro saeva dedisset / funera, tam multis viduasset civibus urbem.
source.text_english: I would not now anywhere be torn from your sweet embrace, my son, nor would Mezentius ever, insulting this head so near at hand, have dealt so many cruel deaths with the sword, or deprived the city of so many citizens.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: illumetu tantum non indignantibus undis hoc caput accipias et pressam regibus alnum.
reuse.text_original: †illumetu tantum / non indignantibus undis / hoc caput accipias et pressam regibus alnum.
reuse.text_english: may you receive this head, the waves almost not indignant, and the alder-tree, pressed down by kings.
